title: What's new in v0.1.13
notes: Windows: typing `cd` no longer parks the caret between `c` and `d`. The host-menu dummy hint is a space (not U+200B), and the grid gives ZWSP a cell so a ConPTY CUB cannot walk back onto the last character.
body:
### Fixed

- Windows: typing `cd` no longer parks the caret between `c` and `d`. The host-menu dummy hint is a space (not U+200B), and the grid gives ZWSP a cell so a ConPTY CUB cannot walk back onto the last character.
